anchors.source_excerpt: Giant worms tear open huge passageways through the deserts in the west. It is said great riches lie buried beneath the sand, still decorating the corpses of those who went there seeking great riches.
The target's strength is increased by %d by the thrill of combat.
10% chance to shimmer to a different hue and gain powers
Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.

You have trained to be very light on your feet and have conditioned your reflexes to react faster than thought to damage you take.
		While this talent is active, you instantly react to any direct damage (not from status effects, etc.) that
You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
Have you heard, the old forest seems to have been claimed by a new evil!

#GOLD#Mental speed#LAST#
Mental speed represents how fast you use psionic abilities compared to normal.
Higher is faster.
Ah yes, my men have found that in Grushnak Pride. Here:

observations.conclusion: 原文说宝物仍点缀着先行者的尸体；译文改成“更多的便是寻宝人的尸体”，叙述事实改变。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
“thrill of combat”（战斗的兴奋）译为“紧张的战斗”，改变原因。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
固定源码 world-artifacts.lua URESLAK_FEMUR（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：onTakeoff 随机改写 name/damtype/wielder 再 onWear，是变换颜色并替换元素能力的套装，非“增加强度”。surface 与 contextual 两轮同因，确认。
“store entrance spotted”漏掉 spotted（已发现）。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
“swoops down upon you”俯冲动作漏译。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
固定源码 talents/techniques/mobility.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：条件为 at least <阈值>% of your maximum life。译文“超过你 …最大生命值”更改阈值边界，排除等于阈值的情形；属可由源码客观判定的量词边界错误，确认。
Spawn Event 的 Spawn 译为“触发”，Debug 标签语义偏移；表层一轮且交叉复核判 OK，记 advisory。
源文标签后尾随空格，译文丢失。单轮空白差异，按既定裁定记 advisory。
“defend it at all costs”译为“不择手段的攻击你”，动作由守卫变攻击。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。

固定源码 old-forest/npcs.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：Wrathroot/Shardskin on_die 调 activateBackupGuardian("SNAPROOT",3,50,...)，SNAPROOT 是占据旧林的后备守卫；“claimed by a new evil”是新的邪恶势力宣称占有，非泛称新怪物出现。两轮同因，确认。
漏译“compared to normal”（相对普通速度）。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
源文标签后尾随空格，译文丢失。单轮空白差异，记 advisory。
Onslaught 译为“围攻”并增添“圣域”。仅表层一轮命名判断，记 advisory。
源文标签后尾随空格，译文丢失。单轮空白差异，记 advisory。
Writ Large 译为“符文亲和”，含义不符。仅表层一轮命名判断，记 advisory。
原文只说“that”，译文明确为“这个水晶球”。仅表层一轮增译判断，记 advisory。

固定源码 timed_effects/mental.lua GLOOM_SLOW 与 cursed/gloom.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：type=mental、subtype gloom+slow，activate 对 global_speed_add 减值；“moves reluctantly”是忧郁光环减速，与 Darkness/黑暗无关。两轮同因，确认。
固定源码 talents/misc/inscriptions.lua Rune: Manasurge 与 timed_effects/magical.lua MANASURGE（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：首参是回蓝速率，第三参才是 incMana 瞬回；译文把速率加成读成持续回复总量。两轮同因，确认。
